subject.title: fix(ui): show cross-agent child sessions in the sidebar on request

question: Should the Control UI sidebar offer a default-off “All agents” mode that makes persisted child and spawned sessions from other configured agent scopes directly discoverable?
rationale: The existing session-list contract permits the read and the patch is technically contained, but deciding whether cross-agent transcript discovery belongs in the primary sidebar is a product visibility choice that automation cannot settle.

options.title: Approve the default-off sidebar mode
options.body: Land the explicit opt-in control with its isolated local state and clarify that it affects the sidebar only.

options.title: Keep discovery in agent sections
options.body: Decline the flattened global mode and require cross-agent child discovery through per-agent or parent-child expansion.

options.title: Keep broad discovery off the sidebar
options.body: Close or defer the PR and reserve cross-agent transcript discovery for dedicated Sessions or Tasks surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve the default-off sidebar mode
recommendation.body: Land the explicit opt-in control with its isolated local state and clarify that it affects the sidebar only.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Control UI transcript-navigation work makes this the strongest available product-routing signal.
